output.title: disableHTTPChallengesRole helm value is already set in your values
output.content: The change adds the `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` helm value, which lets cert-manager drop its permission to create pods when HTTP-01 challenges are not required. The environment's values already set the key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`. Inspect the value assigned to it and confirm no Issuer relies on HTTP-01 challenges, since the role provides the permission those challenges need. The summary lists key paths only, not values.
